# Pdfreee

> Pdfreee is a free, privacy-first PDF toolkit that runs entirely in the browser. Files are processed locally on the visitor's device and are never uploaded to a server. No account is required for the core tools.

Canonical site: https://pdfreee.app

## Key pages

- [Home](https://pdfreee.app/): overview of the toolkit and the privacy model.
- [All tools](https://pdfreee.app/tools): the full list of working PDF tools.
- [FAQ](https://pdfreee.app/faq): answers about privacy, limits, and results.
- [How it works](https://pdfreee.app/how-it-works): why files never leave the device.
- [Blog](https://pdfreee.app/blog): practical PDF guides.

## Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://pdfreee.app/merge-pdf): combine multiple PDFs into one document.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfreee.app/split-pdf): split one PDF into several by page range or single pages.
- [Extract pages](https://pdfreee.app/extract-pdf-pages): pull selected pages into a new document.
- [Delete pages](https://pdfreee.app/delete-pdf-pages): remove unwanted pages.
- [Reorder pages](https://pdfreee.app/reorder-pdf-pages): rearrange pages with drag and drop.
- [Rotate PDF](https://pdfreee.app/rotate-pdf): rotate all pages or a selection by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- [Crop PDF](https://pdfreee.app/crop-pdf): trim margins from each edge of every page.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfreee.app/compress-pdf): lossless structural rewrite to reduce size where possible.
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdfreee.app/pdf-to-jpg): render pages to JPG or PNG with optional filters.
- [JPG to PDF](https://pdfreee.app/jpg-to-pdf): combine JPG and PNG images into one PDF.
- [PDF to text](https://pdfreee.app/pdf-to-text): extract selectable text from a PDF.
- [PDF reader](https://pdfreee.app/pdf-reader): view a PDF in the browser.
- [Add page numbers](https://pdfreee.app/add-page-numbers): stamp page numbers.
- [Add watermark](https://pdfreee.app/add-watermark): overlay text watermarks.
- [Edit PDF](https://pdfreee.app/edit-pdf): add text and images to pages.
- [Sign PDF](https://pdfreee.app/sign-pdf): draw or upload a signature and place it on a page.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://pdfreee.app/privacy-policy): documents are processed locally and never uploaded.
- [Cookie policy](https://pdfreee.app/cookie-policy): the core tools need no cookies; optional advertising is opt-in.
- [Terms of use](https://pdfreee.app/terms): terms governing use of the tools.

## Limits and honest scope

- Maximum PDF file size: 300 MB; a warning is shown above 50 MB. Maximum image size: 40 MB.
- Compression is a lossless structural rewrite. It does not re-encode embedded images, so reductions vary by document.
- Text extraction only returns text actually stored in the PDF; scanned image-only PDFs require OCR, which is not yet supported.
- Office/Word/Excel/PowerPoint conversion, OCR, PDF encryption/decryption (protect/unlock), PDF/A validation, and repair are not currently offered.
